data.value: THE BELOVED MEMBERS OF OUR FAMILY

data.name: Description
data.value: Our family is not made up of cats alone! We also have a sweet little Toy Poodle girl who gets along great with our feline friends. They have formed the sweetest friendships and love playing together every day. Here, you will also meet some of our older cats, who may have retired from breeding but will forever remain part of our family. For us, love has no expiry date – once family, always family, and we will cherish and care for them until the very end.
